lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast vertical white lines traversing the torso from the dorsal ridge toward the ventral surface; spacing is relatively uniform with a slight increase in density at the mid-torso region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Visible stripe fragmentation into circular blobs on the lower mid-flank between primary vertical lines 4, 5, and 6.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6-8 distinct white spots is visible on the posterior haunch and upper hind limb, concentrated below the primary stripe terminations.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct white spots on the lateral thigh align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking on the muzzle and a distinct white crescent-shaped patch on the lower throat/neck junction.
